# Time Interval

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TimeInterval>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A bounded stretch of time, optionally open-ended, delimited by a start and/or end instant.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:AbstractIndividual`](http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#AbstractIndividual). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a first-class bounded stretch of time that must itself bear properties — a frame, a granularity, Allen relations to other intervals, or the scope of a [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md); the reify-on-demand sibling of the [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil statement-layer clocks.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a zero-duration point (use [`gmeow:Instant`](gmeow-Instant.md)) and for the lightweight case where a statement merely holds over a period — there the RDF-star gmeow:validFrom/gmeow:validUntil clocks suffice without minting an interval.

### How to use

- Bound it with gmeow:startedAtTime/gmeow:endedAtTime ([xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime), never [xsd:date](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#date) per P3) or gmeow:hasStartInstant/gmeow:hasEndInstant; declare its [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md) (P11) and any [`gmeow:hasGranularity`](../properties/gmeow-hasGranularity.md), then attach Allen relations to peers.

### Examples

- ex:tenureInterval a [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md); [`gmeow:startedAtTime`](../properties/gmeow-startedAtTime.md) "2019-03-01T00:00:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); [`gmeow:hasTemporalFrame`](../properties/gmeow-hasTemporalFrame.md) [`gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian`](../individuals/gmeow-temporalFrameUTCGregorian.md).
